root_cause: The condition `if (keySet.get(keys) == r)` checks for straightforward equivalence but does not consider all scenarios causing a mismatch. This flaw can skip the 0-output condition when the keys exist but the values do not match (i.e., a more comprehensive mismatch check is needed).
suggestion: Suggestion 1. Refactor the Equality Check Replace the faulty condition `if (keySet.get(keys) == r)` with `if (keySet.get(keys) != r)`. This ensures that the logic correctly captures cases where the map contains the keys but with different character values, which should trigger the 0-output case properly.
